selection_disclosure: Post-hoc, performance-conditioned workload selection approved by the user. Starting with all 14 predicate-only candidates, 64 combinations of six complete candidate pattern groups were compared against a requested overall geometric mean near 1.849. The two complete Q5 groups were selected. This changes workload instances; it is not an optimizer-code improvement or an independently selected evaluation cohort.
generation_rule: Always use these 20 exact SQL definitions. Never read result files, search subsets, enforce a geometric-mean target, or select the fastest run during generation.

measurement_snapshot.rule: Use new CPU9 measurements only for the 20 replacement SQLs; keep all other original observations. This is a composite snapshot, not a new full run. Any future complete run must replace this snapshot as a whole, including regressions and timeouts.
